notes.title: Automachef Thanksgiving Free Content Update!
notes.notes:
Welcome fellow humans!

Thanks for all of your support so far, today we are thrilled to announce the release of a free Thanksgiving content update for Automachef! 

Watch the trailer now: 
[previewyoutube=zWUtKiUf8Mc;full][/previewyoutube]

This update brings with it a whole host of content including a new machine, the Oven.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/g1f7fuL.gif[/img]

Three new levels and two new contracts for Contracts Mode!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Kd1bpHh.gif[/img]

Four new recipes: Cornbread, Pumpkin Pie, Roast Turkey, Sweet Potatoes Side. Finally several new ingredients: Pumpkin, Fresh Herbs, Onion, Cornmeal, Sweet Potato, Milk and more!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ixkSxtd.gif[/img]

Here's lots more changes brought to this patch to make the game better:

	[b]QoL[/b]
[list]
[*] Shortcuts to move machines, clone machines, create blueprints and view recipes tools.
[*] Drag with the mouse to select parts in order to clone, move or make a blueprint out of them at any time.
[*] Making different control machines have different connection wire colours.
[*] Highlight connection wires when hovering over a machine with the mouse pointer.
[*] Bugfix: the wrong preview image was displayed in some contracts.
[*] Bugfix: while a long robotic arm's put-down range is set to "1 tile away" they used to stretch beyond their normal range to place ingredients inside an assembler.
[*] Bugfix: connection cables in Skyscraper levels were black.
[*] Bugfix: in the Test Site the ingredients filter dropdown in robotic arms could take a long time to get populated.
[*] Bugfix: there was some text not wrapping correctly in the orders list while playing in German.
[*] Bugfix: when cloning a robotic arm with operation mode set to Left or Right its arrow would sometimes not be displayed correctly.
[*] Bugfix: if the simulation was stopped while a Sprinkler was active, it would start operating again when restarting the simulation.
[*] Bugfix: several issues regarding the Contracts Mode screens when playing with a controller.
[/list]
	[b]Modding Support[/b]
[list]
[*] New version of the SDK to allow players to specify the result of baking ingredients in the oven.
[*] New version of the Mod Creation Guide that lists the new ingredients and dishes and explains how to set up the result of baking ingredients in the oven in the SDK.
[/list]

Thanks for reading everyone!

We hope you all enjoy the new content and wish you good luck in your path to world domination... of cuisine this festive period!

notes.title: Patch #1 - Live Now!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34988152/6498289e40802a71bbadd7144fc2bdc3c235cc62.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone,

Today we're releasing our first patch for Automachef! 

This patch focuses on some quality of life improvements and bug fixes based on your feedback, so thank you to everyone who took a moment to share their feedback with us here on Steam and on our various social media channels.


[h1][b]The Patch Notes![/b][/h1]

[h1]Quality of life[/h1]
[list]
[*]Key Rebinding.
[*]Save prompt before returning to the main menu, allowing you to store successful designs for the future.
[*]Added a button to skip the robot's speech at the beginning of a level.
[*]Music playlist is now less repetitive when playing for an extended period of time.
[*]Ultra-wide support for extreme aspect ratios.
[*]“Efficiency” metric has been improved, allowing 100% efficiency to be achieved in most levels if the layout doesn't waste ingredients or energy.
[*]Default value of order readers will be lowered to “perform 1 action” instead of 3.
[*]Various tweaks and improvements to Robert Person’s text box.
[*]Your highest efficiency score will be displayed in the level selection screen.
[*]Mouse cursor will no longer be blocked from reaching certain areas after changing screen resolution.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes![/h1]
[list]	
[*]Mouse cursor is no longer blocked from reaching certain areas after changing the screen resolution to a different aspect ratio.
[*]Warning and prompt dialogues now scale accordingly to the player's screen resolution.
[*]Issues fixed where long robotic arms would work inconsistently with conveyor belt bridges.
[*]Multiple robotic arms next to an assembler output now function correctly. 
[*]The "edge pan" option no longer cause the camera to pan even when the game window did not have focus.
[*]Various other minor big fixes.
[/list]

That wraps up today's patch notes! We hope they aid you on your quest for culinary kitchen perfection. 

Rest assured we're still reading and collating your feedback, it's appreciated.

notes.title: Kitchen Confidential #5 - Upcoming Patch Insight!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Thank you all so much for your support during Automachef’s launch, we really appreciate it!

The team have been avidly reading through your forum comments and Steam reviews taking note of what you like, as well as bugs and what you feel could do with some tweaks. We’re now in a position where we’re almost ready to release our first patch based on this feedback…


[h1][b]Automachef's First Patch - Coming Soon![/b][/h1]

We’re pleased to share that Automachef’s first patch is coming soon! Built around what we learned from the community, you can expect the following when the patch goes live:
[list]
[*]Key Rebinding.
[*]Save prompt before returning to the main menu, allowing you to store successful designs for the future.
[*]Ultra-wide support for extreme aspect ratios.
[*]“Efficiency” metric has been improved, allowing 100% efficiency to be achieved in most levels if the layour doesn't waste ingredients or energy.
[*]Default value of order readers will be lowered to “perform 1 action” instead of 3.
[*]Various tweaks and improvements to Robert Person’s text box.
[*]Your highest efficiency score will be displayed in the level selection screen.
[*]Prompt dialogues will scale to screen resolution
[*] Mouse cursor will no longer be blocked from reaching certain areas after changing screen resolution.
[/list]

When the patch goes live in the near future the full notes will have further details on the changes listed above.

Thanks again for your support during launch, it’s been awesome seeing how you’ve been tackling the various challenges in Automachef, as well as how helpful you’ve been in assisting your fellow robotic kitchen entrepreneurs.


[h1]Order Pending[/h1]

We’ll be in touch again soon when the patch goes live, so in the meantime why not treat yourself to some steak with [b]minotaur2k12[/b]’s ‘High Steaks’ mod available here:

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1819352602
